rows: obsessed(v)
to completely fill your mind so that you cannot think of anything else, in a way that is not normal
oriented(v)
to direct somebody/something towards something; to make or adapt somebody/something for a particular purpose
prompt(v)
to make somebody decide to do something; to cause something to happen
subsidise(v)
to give money to somebody or an organization to help pay for something; to give a subsidy
sustainable(adj.)
that can continue or be continued for a long time
tattered(adj.)
old and torn; in bad condition
technical(adj.)
connected with the practical use of machines, methods, etc. in science and industry
tertiary(n)
to give money to somebody or an organization to help pay for something; to give a subsidy
vocational(adj.)
connected with the skills, knowledge, etc. that you need to have in order to do a particular job
obsessed(v)

sections.theory:
Reading Comprehension

1. Why do we need more technical education than general education in Pakistan?

2. How did technical education help Japan and Germany recover their economy after World War II?

3. Why is a linkage between the industries and the technical education training centres necessary?

4. What measures do you suggest for improving the technical education structure of Pakistan?

5. How can technical education help in strengthening the economy of Pakistan?

Writing Suggestions

Write an argumentative essay on 'Need for Technical Education in Our Country' by stating and opinion about the topic and list ideas that sport opinion.

Oral Communication

Pakistan needs skilled manpower through technical education for development, while everyone here wants to become an officer by getting general education. This trend must change. Make groups and Discuss.

Vocabulary and Grammar

A. Following are some words related to economics. Place each word in the given blanks that best define this word.

1. client, customer

A ________ is someone who buys goods or services. A ________ receives professional services.

2. career, job

A ________ is what someone does in exchange for money. A ________ is a professional trajectory that includes both past and present jobs.

3. coworkers, colleagues

A ________ is someone who works on your team or for your company. A ________ is a professional who works in your industry, but not necessarily for the same company

4. top-of-the-line, expensive, premium, overpriced

________ simply means that something costs a lot. ________ means that something costs more than it should. ________ and ________ have a positive connotation and communicate that something is high quality.

5. ordinary, standard, run-of-the-mill, , familiar, well-known, common

________ and ________ have a neutral connotation. ________ and ________ have more of a negative connotation. ________ and ________ have a positive connotation.

6. rich, well-off, well-to-do, wealthy

________ is direct term that we often try to avoid. ________ is a more polite way to communicate that someone has a lot of money. ________ and ________ are euphemistic, indirect ways to communicate that someone has a lot of money.

7. approach, method, Strategy, scheme, , plot,

________ and ________ have a negative connotation. ________ and ________ sound more positive.

4. پاکستان کے فنی تعلیم کے ڈھانچے کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے آپ کیا اقدامات تجویز کرتے ہیں؟

5. فنی تعلیم پاکستان کی معیشت کو مضبوط بنانے میں کیسے مدد کر سکتی ہے؟

موضوع کے بارے میں رائے بیان کر کے اور اس رائے کی تائید کرنے والے خیالات کی فہرست بنا کر ’’ہمارے ملک میں فنی تعلیم کی ضرورت‘‘ پر ایک استدلالی مضمون لکھیں۔

زبانی ابلاغ

پاکستان کو ترقی کے لیے فنی تعلیم کے ذریعے ہنرمند افرادی قوت کی ضرورت ہے، جبکہ یہاں ہر کوئی عمومی تعلیم حاصل کر کے افسر بننا چاہتا ہے۔ یہ رجحان بدلنا چاہیے۔ گروہ بنائیں اور بحث کریں۔

Write an argumentative essay on 'Need for Technical Education in Our Country' by stating and opinion about the topic and list ideas that sport opinion.
